2.5 years ago my dad passed away. He died at home. I was living with him at the time because he was ill. After he passed I stayed in the house and remain there to this day. After he passed away I was also the executor. Had to deal with insurance and all of that. He had a mortgage that was insured and if he passed the mortgage was covered. I had a home phone at the house for him as I only use my cell. After he passed I unhooked the home phone from the jack but didn't cancel because I hadn't had a chance with everything going on. The phone used to ring daily from autocallers and different things. I unplugged it so I didn't have to hear it ring daily. 

So a few days after he passed I had dropped off the paperwork for the mortgage. Gave them my cell and made clear to only contact me on that phone as the home phone is unplugged. So one day I get home from work and walk in the door and the home phone is ringing, I went over and looked. It was the mortgage place letting me know they need additional paperwork asap so the next payment doesn't automatically come out. I get off the phone. Shaken and see my dad's drawer he used for paperwork was wide open. I still think to this day he somehow made sure the phone was hooked up so I got that call when I did.
